+class TestIssue11140:
+    def test_constant_not_picked_as_module_docstring(self, pytester: Pytester) -> None:
+        """Test that a constant at the start of a file is not treated as a docstring.
+        
+        This was causing a TypeError when the constant was not a string, as the code
+        tried to check if "PYTEST_DONT_REWRITE" was in the constant.
+        
+        See: https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/11140
+        """
+        pytester.makepyfile(
+            """
+            # A number constant at the start of the file
+            42
+            
+            def test_something():
+                assert True
+        """
+        )
+        result = pytester.runpytest()
+        assert result.ret == 0
